name: Edit Mode And Dialogs
summary: Edit-mode screens, non-PO entry, label-related dialogs, button-based Type, Part, and Location selectors with shared fuzzy search, full active-label column toggling, source-aware save and delete flows, and per-part Dunnage skid counters preserved across the active queue and history archive.

workflowAreas: Dialog-based type, part, and location selection
userActions: Choose a dunnage type from a picker
Choose a part ID limited to the selected type
Choose an Infor Visual location from a fuzzy-search modal
Save edited rows back to history or the active label queue without reinserting duplicates
Delete removed rows from the active label queue or history based on the loaded source
Toggle any available active-label table column in the edit grid
Preserve Dunnage per-part skid counters when rows move from the active queue into history
validationHints: Confirm the Type column opens a Dunnage Type picker and excludes types with no parts
Confirm changing Type clears the current Part ID and the Part picker is scoped to the selected type
Confirm the Location column opens the fuzzy-search picker against Infor Visual warehouse 002
Confirm the fuzzy-search dialog filters results locally for Type, Part ID, and Location selection
Confirm Save Changes persists the remaining edit-mode rows correctly whether the source is Current Labels or History
Confirm removed rows are deleted from dunnage_label_data when Current Labels is the active source
Confirm Clear All Labels immediately clears the Current Labels edit grid when the active queue is archived
Confirm the Columns modal includes the available dunnage_label_data fields, including hidden queue metadata columns
Confirm Dunnage active-label and history rows retain part_skid_sequence and part_skid_total values after save, edit, and archive operations
Confirm a successful save refreshes the same working set and a failed save surfaces a clear error
Confirm edit-mode and non-PO dialog flows still target the correct records
